name: Diffusion-Based 3D Inpainting
definition: A method using a self-trained 2D inpainting diffusion model for 3D inpainting.
summary: Diffusion-Based 3D Inpainting reconstructs missing 3D scene regions using a self-trained 2D inpainting diffusion model, distinguishing itself by explicit pre-training on inpainted data before 3D optimization.
